shortcutTakenFallback: {taken} is already used by another app, so Rumor will use {used}. You'll be able to change it in Settings.
shortcutTakenNone: {taken} is already used by another app. You'll be able to pick another shortcut in Settings.
welcome: Rumor is in the tray. Click to play, right-click for options.
hintStartColor: The one playing when Rumor opens.
hintFade: How long the noise takes to come in and go out when you play or pause.
hintMaxVolume: The volume control's 100 % maps to this level. Handy with headphones.
hintOutputChange: What to do when the sound would move to another output.
policyPauseOnSpeakers: Pause if it moves to speakers
hintResume: If unplugging paused it, plugging them back plays again.
hintOnLaunch: Whether it should start playing by itself.
hintPresets: The panel's three buttons, in minutes.
hintEndFade: When the timer ends, the noise fades out slowly.
hintNotifyEnd: Shows a notification when the timer finishes.
shortcutsIntro: Click a shortcut and press the keys. Esc cancels; Delete clears it.
errTypesCharacter: On your keyboard it types a character with AltGr. Pick another.
hintLeftClick: Right click always opens the panel.
hintShowRemaining: Hovering the icon shows how long the timer has left.
hintTheme: Light, dark or the one Windows uses.
hintAccent: The playing noise's colour or Windows' accent colour.
hintMica: The background lets a little of the desktop through (Windows 11).
hintSpectrum: The sound's curve in the panel.
hintReduceMotion: No halo or movement, just fades.
hintLaunchAtLogin: Rumor appears in the tray when the computer starts.
hintDevice: If you pick a fixed one and it disconnects, Rumor pauses; it never switches output on its own.
hintBuffer: Bigger is steadier; smaller responds sooner. The noise sounds the same.
hintBackup: Save your settings to a file or load them from one.
hintReset: Back to factory values. Your colour, volume and timer are kept.
aboutTagline: Pink, brown and white noise, generated in real time.
aboutTelemetry: No telemetry: Rumor sends nothing anywhere.
aboutBugs: To report a bug, open an issue on GitHub and attach the log (Advanced → Logs).
